title: The walk home: forecourt, plaza, dorm courtyard, room
caption: The four places built overnight, from the station to Eric's room, in the game camera with the interface hidden (build 0930-0524-38755d9).

sections.title: Where they are
sections.caption: The route on the island map you picked (island-map-4): station forecourt, fountain plaza, dorm courtyard, Eric's room.

images.caption: Route on island-map-4

sections.title: Station forecourt (forecourt)
sections.caption: The court between the station's north door and the head office entrance, with bike racks, a bench, a planted bed and the 本社 sign. Eric crosses it to the lift in the morning and walks east along the lane after work.

sections.title: Fountain plaza (plaza)
sections.caption: East of the forecourt: the fountain with its no-coins sign, two benches, the canteen terrace behind and the shop roofs in front. A side trip in the morning, on the way home after work.

sections.title: Dorm courtyard (dorm_court)
sections.caption: Outside Eric's dorm at dusk: the entrance hall with its 24 mailboxes, the coin laundry on the left, the sento on the right and the bike shelter in front.

sections.title: Eric's room (dorms)
sections.caption: His tiny room: bed, desk, two shipped boxes and one window onto a concrete wall, with the kitchenette and unit bath by the door. The day ends here.
